clues.text: When its people heard Samson was in town, they lay in wait all night at the city gate to kill him at dawn.
After the Philistines blinded Samson, they bound him in bronze shackles here and made him grind grain in prison.
An angel told Philip to get up and go south to the desert road running down from Jerusalem to this city.
Amos said God would not revoke His judgment on this city for exiling a whole population to Edom.
When the Philistines sent back the ark, one gold tumor was for this city, one of their five.
Joshua wiped out the Anakim from the land, but some survived in this city, along with Gath and Ashdod.
Zechariah foretold that this Philistine city would writhe in agony and would no longer have a king.
